sections.heading: Five more Grandmaster rewards, each once a day (resets at midnight UTC)
items: Blunt (at 100): type /breaker, then open a locked dungeon chest within ten minutes with a war axe, mace, battleaxe or warhammer in hand: you smash the lock open instead of picking it.
Miner (at 100): type /prospect to sense which way the nearest rare vein lies, and how far. If nothing rare is near, the day's use is kept.
Cook (at 100): type /feast to serve everyone within a few steps, up to ten guests: all of you eat your fill and are Well Fed for six hours. Each guest can be fed at one feast a day.
Defense (at 100): stand over a fallen player and type /shieldover. For a minute nobody can finish them, unless you are staggered, your guard breaks, or you step away.
Martial Arts (at 100): the first time each day you go down fighting with fists or a staff, and not in heavy armour, you get straight back up with a little health.
/capstone shows your reward and whether today's use is ready.
